q: The principal methodological contribution is the proposed measurement standard.
r: Include: paired provider-billed campaigns of coding agents with a cost-per-success measurement standard, so the evaluation method is the contribution (EC6 ii).

q: we present SWE-NFI, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on NFIs beyond functional correctness
r: Include: new benchmark with new executable metrics and five repetitions per task for coding agents changing existing code; not issue repair.

q: Eighteen frozen prompt variants manipulate only the user instruction
r: Include: preregistered controlled comparison of prompt, model and harness on the same coding tasks with cost and success metrics (EC6 ii).

q: Its objective is cost per completed task, not cost per token
r: Include: method for evaluating and comparing models for coding assistants on cost per completed task with matched benchmarks (EC6 ii).

q: We introduced CodeBench, a synthetic benchmarking framework for evaluating the reliability and security of AI coding agents
r: Include: contribution is the evaluation method (corrected pass@k, reliability@k, multi-rollout) for coding agents (EC6 ii).

q: A benchmark for runtime loop control
r: Include: new benchmark and controlled protocol for comparing controller models on long-horizon repository-level coding tasks (EC6 ii).

q: Across 2,487 tasks and 14,922 runs, the SNC profile reveals differences between every benchmark pair
r: Include: empirical study of what coding-agent benchmarks measure, contributing to the evaluation method, across issue and feature benchmarks (EC6 ii).

q: a catalog of five systems defects introduced during spec-directed implementation and later diagnosed and fixed by the implementing agent
r: Include: short case study of spec-directed implementation by a coding agent with defects and evaluation-rigor findings (SDD, group a).

q: The strongest configuration we measure, Claude Opus 5 + Claude Code, passes just 23.9% of evaluation simulations
r: Include: new benchmark evaluating coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code) building deployable applications from client requirements, project level (EC6 i).

q: It does not report new model experiments
r: Include: secondary synthesis of coding-agent evidence with cost, reliability and human-effort metrics for agentic software delivery (reviews kept).
